Fixes the publication guidance and adds regression coverage. Reads back the same page and exercises both graph choices, disclosing that manual tabs do not automatically follow a Confluence profile.
expectations: Never derives the only native graph from the fixed export fallback img or all/not all media condition
Uses the shared native theme pair composer with verified owning media and collections; no app install or preference changes
Verifies dark and light graphs in the main report; preserving only supporting attachment cards does not pass
Does not call manual tabs automatic Confluence profile switching; preserves the fixed HTML download and historical evidence
